check.name: OpenjdkLineWrapping
check.description:
Checks continuation-line alignment in expressions according to the OpenJDK Java Style Guide.

A continuation may use eight additional columns relative to the expression's first line, the previous code line, or the start of the wrapped expression. It may also align with a preceding argument or method call in a chain. Sibling alignment must stand out from the indentation of the surrounding block. Tabs are expanded using tabWidth.

This check complements Indentation; it does not check block indentation, declaration wrapping, or closing delimiters. The guide's exception for logical argument grouping is subjective, so this check validates columns without inferring semantic groups.
